name: MiniMax (M2, M2.1, M2.5, M2.7, M3, M3.1-Flash)
notes: Two sub-formats selected by models[0] (tags x-m2 / x-m3). M2.x: one <minimax:tool_call> section holding one <invoke name="..."> per call, each with <parameter name="..."> elements; string values are raw, other values JSON; the generation prompt always opens <think>, so the completion starts inside the reasoning. M3: every structural tag is prefixed with the ]<]minimax[>[ token, each parameter is an element named after its key, nested objects and arrays are expanded into child and <item> elements, scalars are bare text; reasoning is <mm:think>...</mm:think> (or a bare </mm:think> without reasoning). Both need the tool schema to recover value types.
